method: GTA-AVT-v1.1: reliability-aware local conditional fusion with Gaussian supervision
status: algorithm development only; no dataset training authorized

attribute.support_target: GT lumen occupancy per half-resolution cell, separate from geometry measurability
attribute.radius_target: same TRAIN-standardized physical log-radius on original r_valid only
attribute.unknown_radius: weak KL N(mu,var)||N(0,1) on unknown real cells; normalize unknown foreground/background separately; no fake measured radius-zero labels
attribute.confidence: relu((1-var)/(1+var)); relative information score, not claimed calibrated uncertainty
attribute.support_loss: case-equal soft-target Dice+BCE; a support score, not calibrated confidence

batch_keys.label: full resolution binary lumen
batch_keys.gdf_valid: full target validity incl real foreground when prepared

routing: v0.1 four branches+576 coefficients, no hard applicability threshold; g=tanh(b+u*v+w*cR); static C0 reference b retained; branch coefficients bounded
local_modes: all BN/dropout eval, P+remaining S frozen; GDF gradients reach active routing through frozen layers
validation: primary Dice selection, record BCE ties/GDF separately; real VAL foreground GDF prepared; readiness checks direct support overlap+R vs prior and usable reliability, not nonconstant prediction alone
no_old_scores: v0.1/v1 results are design evidence only, never relabelled as v1.1 outcomes
